title: Enforce a context-replay budget per fleet leaf
assumptions: Landed the SMALLEST coherent slice: the per-leaf context-budget enforcement primitive (declared budget with a sane default DEFAULT_LEAF_CONTEXT_BUDGET_TOKENS=200000 + config override) enforced fail-loud at dispatch. Used 'Refs #1524' (not 'Closes') because the issue's batching and outline/unfold-routing deliverables are deferred to follow-up slices.

Deferred to follow-up slices under #1524: (1) batching queue items per leaf to amortise the load; (2) routing leaf context through code_outline/code_unfold/find_context_for by default; (3) wiring the measured post-hoc cache-read into the lane provenance (the LeafContextSpend.cacheReadTokens field is defined but filled only once wired — the burn package already attributes cache-read per-lane via agentId); (4) the A/B-on-a-fixture-fleet acceptance criterion, which is a property of the batching/routing slices, not the enforcement primitive.
The budget ceiling is on the ASSEMBLED per-leaf context size (the number fan-out multiplies), not on cumulative replay (context_size x turns). Default 200000 tokens ~= a full large context window.

Primitives are pure/offline (no fs, no network, no token-counting library): the caller supplies the estimate, the primitive decides. This mirrors the fleet/claims module split (types own the shape, core owns the logic).

Kept the change localized to a NEW additive fleet/context-budget module to avoid colliding with sibling lanes #1525 (budget governor) and #1532 (rate-limit-aware fan-out), which touch adjacent shared dispatch/governor internals. No shared dispatch/governor file was refactored.

The canonical contract is stated once in docs/reference/fleet-family.md (new section 'The per-leaf context-replay budget'); individual member SKILL.md files reference it rather than restate it, so no per-fleet SKILL.md edit (and no 4-platform-mirror change) was needed for this slice.
